intro: A figure in a stained lab coat steps out from behind a rock, staring at your party with wide, delighted eyes.
speaker: The Geneticist
introDialogue: Three. THREE of the same specimen, kept and cherished!$Do you know how rare it is to meet someone who appreciates beautiful redundancy?$Common splicers waste half a creature. I discard nothing. Let me show you what duplication is truly for.
title: The Geneticist
description:
The Geneticist offers a splice far beyond any DNA Splicer: choose a body and a material, and the engineered fusion will wield both their abilities at once, inherit the strict best of two stats, and bear a typing of your design.
The material will be consumed. The fusion's dormant passive will be forever spent.

1.label: Offer Two Pokémon
1.tooltip:
(+) Engineered fusion: both abilities, hybrid vigor stats, chosen typing
(-) The material Pokémon is consumed
1.materialPrompt: And which shall be the material?
1.selected: The Geneticist's machine hums to life…$"Hold still. Perfection takes a moment."

2.label: Refuse
2.selected: The Geneticist sighs and shutters the machine.$"A waste. All that beautiful redundancy…"

spliceComplete: The chamber opens, and {{splicedName}} steps out — reborn!$Hybrid vigor surges through its {{vigorStat1}} and {{vigorStat2}}!
outro: The Geneticist packs up the machine, muttering happily about your contribution to science.
